acceptance_criteria.criterion: docs/plugins.md removes the ledger plugin section but retains the plugin interface documentation, and includes a note that the ledger plugin has migrated to ai-insights-dev
All three project-manifest files (api-surface.md, file-tree.md, data-flows.md) no longer reference the ledger plugin
CHANGELOG.md contains an entry for the upcoming 2.0.0 release documenting the ledger plugin removal as a breaking change

summary: Updated all persona-builder documentation to reflect ledger plugin removal. (1) docs/plugins.md: removed the full Ledger Plugin detail section (ledgerPlugin factory, LedgerPluginOptions, validators, renderers, frontmatter constants, severity escalation pattern, cache key conventions) and replaced it with a concise migration notice explaining the plugin has moved to ai-insights-dev at personas/plugins/ledger/. (2) docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md: removed the entire 'Ledger Plugin — @mistralys/persona-builder/plugins/ledger' section including all exported types, functions, and constants. File now ends cleanly at ValidationResult. (3) docs/agents/project-manifest/file-tree.md: removed the src/plugins/ledger/ subtree entries and updated tsup.config.ts note from 'three entry points: index, cli, plugins/ledger/index' to 'two entry points: index, cli'. (4) docs/agents/project-manifest/data-flows.md: already contained no ledger-specific references — no changes needed. (5) CHANGELOG.md: added [2.0.0] - Upcoming entry with a Breaking Changes section documenting the removal of the ./plugins/ledger sub-path export and the migration to ai-insights-dev.

comments.note: The plugins.md 'Validator Severity Escalation Pattern' and 'Cache Key Conventions for Multi-Target Builds' subsections were valuable architectural guidance. Now that the ledger plugin is gone from this library, those patterns are preserved as general advice in the plugin examples section — both the 'Custom frontmatter template via plugin' and 'Validation plugin' examples still illustrate the same patterns for custom plugin authors.

The tests/plugins section in file-tree.md still shows '27 tests' for plugin system tests. This count included the ledger plugin tests that WP-003 removed. The actual count will now be lower, but updating exact test counts is beyond documentation scope and should be updated when the test suite is next re-run.
